item.title: Gunsmoke - Harvest
item.description: Ben Payson's daughter falls for one of the Scottish homesteaders who have threatened to take his land.

item.title: The Big Valley - Night in a Small Town
item.description: Tom Wills is marshal in a small town that he cleaned up and keeps on a very tight leash. Heath is disturbed to find just how much power his old friend has.

item.title: Wagon Train - The Sally Potter Story
item.description: Sally Potter hitches a ride on the wagon train and finds that being pretty helps and hurts her. Someone she knew catches up to the train and wants to remind her of who she is and where she came from, possibly ruining what she wants for her future.

item.title: The Wild Wild West - The Night of the Golden Cobra
item.description: A maharajah needs a tutor in the fine art of killing for his sons... and kidnaps Jim West to handle the job.

item.title: Bugs Bunny and Friends - Mutiny on the Bunny, Soup Or Sonic, Aloha Hooey, A Wild Hare, Nuts And Volts, Acrobatty Bunny

item.title: The Woody Woodpecker Show - The Screwball, Dig That Dog, Clash and Carry, The Beach Nut, Hyde and Sneak, Eggnapper, The Coo Coo Bird
item.description: "Woody Woodpecker tries to sneak into a baseball game, but a policeman gets in his way., A man's new, little puppy grows into a giant dog with a digging problem., After an unsuccessful stealing attempt, Chilly Willy buys out all the fish in Wally's store on credit., Woody Woodpecker ruins Wally's day at the beach., Inspector Willoughby tries to catch a jewel thief named Vampira Hyde, who takes pills that transform her appearance., When tourist season is over and the park ranger leaves the bears

item.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Cruise Cat, Discontented Canary, Fine Feathered Friend
item.description: "Tom needs to keep Jerry off a Honolulu bound ship or he will no longer be the mascot., Unhappy with his life in a cage, a canary escapes but soon finds that life in the wild isn’t as great as he thought it would be., Jerry pretends to be a chick so the mother hen protects him from Tom."

item.title: Popeye and Pals - Olive Oyl For President, Be Kind to “Aminals”, Taxi-Turvy, Leave Well Enough Alone
item.description: "Tired of political rhetoric, Olive lays out her platform., Popeye and Olive see Bluto driving a wagon hitting his weak-looking horse because he cannot pull the wagon., Popeye and Bluto compete in the taxi business., Popeye, saddened by the sight of dogs in a pet shop, buys them and releases them into the streets."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed Becomes a Movie Mogul
item.description: Drysdale buys a movie studio, Mammoth Pictures, for Jed, and the Clampetts decide to go check out their new property. At first they can’t get in, but they finally succeed. They meet Lawrence Chaplin, the head of Mammoth Pictures, who refers to Jed as a Zucker and a Roach, and Jed admires him for saying it to his face.

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jethro's Graduation
item.description: Jethro is very excited about graduating from the sixth grade. But in order to prevent embarrassment, Mrs. Potts gets help from Drysdale and Diana to get Jethro to miss his sixth grade graduation. She schemes to turn Jed and Jethro’s watches back 45 minutes.
